investigation_notes.Description: An unusually high number of SharePoint file downloads (305) was observed for acc@globalcorp.ee, which is well above the 24-hour baseline of 28. The activity originated from Tampere, Finland and was performed via the Mepco MSGraph integration against the site named 'Finland_HR_Mepco_Sync', with a user agent consistent with automated integration clients. The site name, application, and file paths indicate a scheduled Mepco synchronization of HR and finance documents, making this activity consistent with authorized integration behavior and therefore assessed as Low Priority.
